Invincible for 5 sec. Activates 2 time(s) per battle.

caveats: ⚑ Base weapon cadence tuple (RL, ammo 6, reloadFrames 141, chargeFrames 60) is datamined and unverified — shot count, and therefore this unit's own damage contribution, rides on it.

⚑ Burst line 'Recovers 55.44% of attack damage as HP over 10 sec' is a LIFESTEAL, not a periodic heal. Modeled as a 10-tick heal (1/sec) purely so the recovery CHANNEL exists for on-recovery consumers (heal-synergy kits). The tick cadence is invented; a real lifesteal fires once per damage instance, so an on-recovery consumer is likely UNDER-credited here. No HP amount is modeled either way.

Skill 2 is entirely unmodeled: its trigger is an ally HP threshold and the v1 boss deals no damage, so it can never fire. Both the invincibility and the 23.26% Max-HP heal are therefore inert. If a heal-synergy teammate is present, this under-credits them by up to 2 recovery events per battle.
'Affects all Supporter allies' is read as INCLUDING this unit (a Supporter) — no excludeSelf. Same for 'all Attacker allies' on skill 1, which cannot include this unit.
Skill 1 crit is scoped: 'Critical Rate of normal attack' → critRateNormalPct, NOT generic critRatePct (a generic model would over-credit every Attacker ally's skill and burst damage).
noFb is not set anywhere: this kit contains no damage lines at all, so the flag has no surface to apply to. noRange is engine-automatic and untouched.
note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Biscuit is a pure support kit — zero damage lines, zero weapon-state modifiers, no stacks, no swap, no DoT. Modeled: skill 1 fires at Full-Burst END (fullBurstEnd, not fullBurstEnter) granting all Attacker allies scoped normal-attack Critical Rate ▲5.77%/10s plus a 10-tick heal-over-time (1/sec, kit-stated cadence) whose only sim-visible role is emitting recovery events; burst fires on this unit's own cast (burstCast) granting all Supporter allies (self included) ATK ▲43.08%/10s plus a lifesteal channel proxied as a 10-tick heal. Skill 2 and the burst's cover-rebuild branch are unmodeled — both are gated on mechanics the v1 sim has no state for (ally HP pool, destroyed cover), and neither can ever fire against a boss that deals no damage. The two ATK/crit numbers and both durations are read verbatim from kit prose; nothing here is calibrated to any board reading.
